Irene: Quick heads up  Oceanbridge case study interview tomorrow 9am PT. Need: 1 short blog quote, 1 webinar-ready 20s clip, demo b-roll (10s). Can legal review any candidate quote same-day?
Noah: I'll record and drop assets to Drive. Will capture a clean 20s clip where customer reads a single sentence.
UploadBot: File created: https://drive.redwood/oceanbridge/session_3599.mp4
Ben (sales): For webinar lead routing we need a one-field form (email) + a checkbox for 'request demo'. Can I get a 1-line approved quote by noon for SDRs?
Maya (legal): Any numeric claims need explicit written permission. If customer mentions numbers live, please get an email confirmation. Otherwise we'll publish non-numeric language like "significant reduction in inference cost."
Irene: Candidate (raw) from Oceanbridge: "Switching to Redwood dropped our inference charges by ~30% and improved tail latency." Pasting for legal.
Maya (legal): Please change `~30%` to `substantial` or attach signed permission. Also remove internal metric names like "tail" if possible.
Noah: I'll ask the customer for a signed quote with numbers; if not, I'll record them reading the cleaned line: "We saw substantial savings in per-request cost and faster latency."
Ben (sales): Great. I'll build the Typeform + SFDC webhook named "Oceanbridge Webinar" and set SDR routing rules. ETA EOD.
Irene: Perfect. Next steps: Noah upload transcript + clip, Maya confirm wording by EOD, Ben build form. Ping here if blocked. :rocket:
